type: zone de fin de donjon / arène naturelle
queue_source: REPRISE_MAPS.md: après FST1, prochaine fin de la série = Clairière tropicale
biome_selection: choix de l'agent d'après la file locale; le nom canonique/la portée de cette fin n'ont pas été confirmés par l'utilisateur

reference_context.limitation: L'image canonique et les bruts ETC1 ne sont pas présents dans ce checkout; les mesures écrites d'ETC1 servent de guide de teinte seulement, pas de référence visuelle directe.

images.prompt: Create one standalone full-frame overhead game-map composition, landscape 4:3, strict top-down orthographic view, matching the readable pixel-art style and lush tropical palette of a classic Pokémon Mystery Dungeon dungeon. This is a beautiful final clearing deep in a tropical jungle, designed as a large boss arena. Layout: a narrow natural-earth passage opens from the SOUTH edge into a wide, uncluttered oval clearing; keep the central arena broad and fully open. At the NORTH edge of the clearing, make a distinctive ancient tree-root arch with a small shaded alcove at its foot as a quiet objective focal point, not a portal. Enclose the clearing with layered dark-green jungle canopy, broad-leaf plants, a few coconut palms, and restrained clusters of red, yellow and pink hibiscus around the outer rim; keep all plants out of the playable central arena. Ground is natural warm soil and soft yellow-green grass with fine irregular texture and occasional tiny leaf litter, not paved. Preserve clear north-south route and closed natural walls at top and sides. Rich depth, refined composition, varied plant silhouettes, clean high-quality pixel clusters, strong readable contrast at small game-map scale. No crystals or gemstones, no tiles, no paving slabs, no checkerboard, no stepping stones, no water, no characters, no monsters, no text, no UI, no border, no watermark.

images.method: image edit of the selected full composition
images.prompt: Edit this map to make its aligned full-floor companion. Keep exactly the same canvas size, overhead view, pixel-art rendering and light yellow-green grass texture from the open central clearing. Replace all jungle, trees, roots, flowers, dirt entrances, path marks, leaves and shadows with continuous matching grass; fill the entire image edge to edge with natural grass only. Use the clearing's current muted spring-green palette, fine irregular blade clusters and sparse tiny grass flecks, with no large patterns. Absolutely no objects, plants, rocks, dirt, path, tiles, paving, crystals, text, border or camera change.

palette_correction.method: apply a low-strength per-channel shift only to pixels classified as clear grass, toward ETC1's recorded rip grass mean
